effects.description: Blunt hit: jagged hit spark, star glint, shock ring, spray of sparks and settling embers
Blade cut: white-edged crescent sweep, second echo crescent, contact spark and steel sparks
Critical: converging speed lines, X-slash, hit spark, radiant burst, double shock ring, star rain
Electric orb/impact: hot core, flickering bolts, star burst, crackling sparks, ribbon trail
Fireball: hit spark, cel explosion flipbook, flame lick, ember spray and dark smoke, hot trail
Fire column: glowing floor scorch, two staggered flame flipbooks, heat pillar, cinders and smoke
Frost burst: crystal cluster erupts, snowflake seal spins out, ice shards, frost mist and glints
Holy/frost seal at the target: rune ring on the floor, light pillar, star glint, orbiting motes
Casting seal under the caster: converging ring, counter-rotating rune circles, rising motes
Healing: leaf-green seal, soft pillar, rising crosses and leaves, body bloom, sparkles
Resurrection: sun seal, heaven pillar, unfolding wings, halo, feather fall and rising light
Toxic/dark cloud: small pop, two waves of cel smoke puffs, bubbles and specks
Enhancement: golden seal, rising chevrons orbit, upward motes, light column, finishing glint
Weakening: abyss sigil, sinking chevrons, spectral skull, dark smoke and falling motes
Guard: hex barrier shell flashes, ring pulse, star glint and chips of light
Sustained hexagonal shield shell with a floor ring and slow drifting motes
Barrier break: hit spark, shell pops, shard spray, shock ring and an anger mark
Summoning: abyss sigil and rune band, opening void rift with glowing seam, circling skulls
Dark burst: imploding ring, abyss vortex, hit spark, shadow smoke, flung spirits and violet embers
Holy strike: pillar from above, radiant wedge burst, sun seal, cross flash and feather fan
Arrow hit: light-arrow streak, small hit spark, tight shock ring, focused sparks
Heavy blow: hit spark, shock ring, floor ring, dust cloud, flying rock chips and sparks
Lightning strike: two staggered bolts from above, white flash, floor ring, sparks and static
Heaven rend: focus lines, the sky tears open in a seam of light, a giant holy sword drops, a vertical heaven-splitting cut and X-slash, heaven pillar, triple shock and star storm

Meteor: grand arcane seals, a portal opens in the sky, a colossal burning meteor and a shower of smaller ones crash into the group - crater blast, flame columns, shockwaves, flying rock, ember storm and smoke
Starfall volley: twin seals in the sky loose a storm of shooting stars and light arrows over the group, star glints burst on the ground, shock ring and motes
Seraph hymn: sun seal, heaven pillar, great seraph wings and halo, hymn glyphs and notes circle the party, radiant burst, feather fall and rising light
Knight: azure guard seal and hex bulwark, then a sweeping shield-cleave and blue shock
Paladin: sun seal, heaven pillar with a descending holy sword, unfolding wings, radiant burst
Berserker: red focus lines, two frenzied claw rakes, X-slash, blood spray and rage embers
Warlord: crimson war sigil, ground-shattering explosion, double crimson shockwave, rocks and embers
Elementalist: fire and ice spirits orbit a rune circle with sparks, then converge in a prismatic blast
Archmage: three stacked arcane seals (floor, air, sky), a meteor streaks down, grand explosion
Warlock: violet curse sigil, tightening vortex, circling skull wisps, shadow smoke, curse pop
Abyssal: cyan-violet twin sigils, a void rift tears open with a glowing seam, vortex, abyss smoke
Sniper: lock-on reticle and ring converge, then a piercing light arrow, focus lines and sharp burst
Divine Archer: golden sun seal opens in the sky and rains golden arrows; sparkling impacts
Ranger: leaf storm whirls around a green seal, two wind cuts and a burst of leaves
Shadow Stalker: vanishes in shadow smoke, three violet blade arcs, X-slash, dark burst
Priest: blessing seal, soft light pillar, rising crosses and petals, warm bloom and sparkles
Saint: great halo above, heaven pillar, rain of healing light and crosses, radiant bloom
Exorcist: upright holy seal spins open, cross flash, spirits flung out, holy shock and stars
Inquisitor: crimson sigil, judgment pillar and giant crimson cross impale the target, red shock
Weapon enchant on the caster: spinning seal, body glow, orbiting glints and rising element embers
Battle shout: radial focus lines, double shockwave, anger mark, rising aura flames and embers
Power-up aura: spinning seal, aura column and flames, orbiting chevrons, rising motes, finishing glint
Flame blade: white crescent cut that bursts into a cel explosion, ember spray and smoke
Frost blade: crescent cut, ice crystal erupts from the wound, shard spray and frost mist
Thunder blade: crescent cut with a bolt striking the blade, crackling sparks, floor ring
Holy blade: crescent cut, radiant cross and sunburst, feather fan
Hellfire field: wide rune seal and scorch, flame columns and explosions erupting across the group, giant hit flash and shock ring, ember storm, rolling smoke
Glacier field: snowflake seal, ice crystals erupting across the group, falling snow, frost flash, shard spray and freezing mist
Thunderstorm: storm cloud overhead, bolts raining down across the group, white flash, wide floor ring, crackling sparks
Divine judgment: floor and sky sun seals, light lances raining down, light pillars, giant sunburst, feather storm
Void field: abyss sigil, imploding ring, ground vortex and rising vortex, shadow smoke, flung spirits, violet ember storm
Earthquake: giant ground shockwave and floor ring, focus lines, flash, rock eruption and dust across the group, spark spray
Sweeping cleave: three huge crescents sweep across the group, spark spray, wide floor ring
Whirlwind: wind funnel spins up in the middle of the group, crossing gale crescents, swirling leaves and wind glints, wide floor ring
Arrow storm: seal opens in the sky, a dense rain of light arrows over the whole group, ground glints, wide ring and motes
Toxic miasma: curse seal, rolling cel smoke over the group, rising bubbles and specks
Healing rain: wide leaf seal and ring, rain of soft light, rising crosses and leaves, bloom, sparkles
Party blessing: wide golden seal and ring, chevrons circling the party, light pillars, ember fountain, finishing glint
Curse field: abyss seal, circling skull spirits and sinking chevrons over the group, creeping smoke, falling motes
Mass resurrection: double sun seal, colossal heaven pillar, unfolding great wings and halo, feather fall, rising light, white flash
Aegis: a huge hexagonal dome closes over the party, blue seal and ring, glint, chips of light, motes
Life drain: closing ring and shrinking vortex, motes and spirits sucked into the target, pop, smoke
Sleep mist: dreamy seal, drifting pastel mist over the group, circling Zzz, bubbles, soft stars
Flash bang: blinding hit spark, spinning sunburst, focus lines, shock ring and star spray
Warrior ultimate II: sky and floor seals, colossal sword falls, two giant crescents and an X-slash split the field, explosion, shock ring, rock and ember storm

Fire casting: flame rune seal, converging ring, flame tongues licking up around the caster, embers
Ice casting: snowflake seal and counter-rune, ice shards spiral in, frost motes rise, cold glow
Thunder casting: pentagram seal, crackling sparks around the caster, small bolts flicker, static glow
Holy casting: sun seal, halo above the head, motes of light falling in, rising sparkles
Dark casting: abyss sigil, imploding ring, violet motes and wisps sucked into the caster, shadow smoke
Healing casting: leaf seal, soft glow, petals and leaves rising around the caster
Archer focus: lock-on reticle closes on the bow, converging ring and focus lines, gathering light
Ultimate casting: twin grand seals, aura column, converging focus lines, orbiting stars, ember fountain
Ice lance: long faceted spear of ice along its flight, cold glow, spinning snowflake, frost trail
Void lance: black-violet spear with a spinning void swirl at its head and a smoky trail
Spark orb: crackling ball of lightning, flickering bolts, star glint, electric trail
Spirit fire: blue-violet will-o-wisp flame with a ghost face, ghostly trail
Flame arrow: burning light arrow, flame tongue streaming back, hot trail
Frost arrow: light arrow with an ice tip, frost glint, cold trail
Thunder arrow: light arrow wrapped in crackling bolts, electric trail
Holy arrow: golden light arrow, spinning star at the head, bright trail
Shadow needle: violet light arrow with a void swirl, smoky trail
Venom arrow: green arrow dripping toxic bubbles, green trail
Sleep arrow: pastel arrow with a soft star, dreamy pink-blue trail
Flame arrow hit: arrow streak punches in, hit spark, burst of flame, ember spray, smoke wisp
Blaze: a spiralling fire tornado engulfs the target, flame columns, scorch ring, ember storm and smoke
Flame wave: a ring of fire rolls outward across the group, flame tongues, explosions, ember storm
Hell flame: blood-red abyss seal, black-crimson fire geysers erupting all over the group, skulls in the flames, giant flash and double shockwave, cinder storm and black smoke
Inferno: wide scorch seal, flame columns and explosions erupting across the group, ember storm, smoke
Solar flare: a blazing sun swells overhead, scorching rays rain down, white-out flash, burning floor
Fire breath: a rolling torrent of flame washes over the group, billowing fire, cinders and black smoke
Sun judgment: a solar seal opens in the sky and drops a colossal pillar of sun-fire, crater blast
Blazing arrow rain: a fire seal in the sky rains burning arrows and meteors, the floor erupts in flame
Ice lance hit: the spear drives in and shatters - long frost streak, ice spike, hit spark, shard spray, snowflake bloom and frost mist
Glacial spike: giant ice spikes burst up from the floor around and through the target, frost flash, shard spray and freezing mist
Frost nova: a freezing ring explodes outward from the centre, ice crystals snap up in a ring, white flash, shards and snow mist
Blizzard: a howling snow storm - grey-white cloud overhead, dense driving snow, swirling wind funnel, frost mist over the group
Freezing tide: a surging wave of icy water sweeps the group and freezes - bubbles and spray, droplets, ice crystals locking up, frost ring
Absolute zero: a colossal snowflake seal and sky seal, the whole field crystallises into giant ice, white-out flash, then everything shatters into a storm of shards and freezing mist
Frost arrow hit: arrow streak, frost bloom of crystals and snowflake, hit spark, shards and mist
Spark hit: crackling electric pop - hot core, star glint, two quick bolts, spark spray, static motes
Chain spark: arcs leap sideways into the target - horizontal bolts, crackle flash, sparks and ring
Lightning bolt: one colossal bolt cracks down from the sky onto the target, double flash, scorch ring, spark fountain and static
Thunder storm: dark storm cloud over the group, many bolts raining down, white flashes, wide floor ring, crackling sparks

Indra, heavenly thunder: a divine seal opens high in the sky, a god-pillar of lightning slams the centre while a ring of bolts strikes around it, white-out flash, double shockwave and an electric storm
Thunder arrow hit: arrow streak, a bolt answers from the sky onto the arrow, flash, sparks, ring
Giga slash: a colossal lightning-charged crescent cleaves the whole field, thunder column at the centre, X-slash, white flash, shock ring and electric storm
Banish: an upright holy seal opens over the target, it is swallowed by white light, cross flash, motes lift away as the evil is erased
Holy lance: a giant spear of light plunges from the sky into the target, cross flash, sun seal, light shockwave, feather fan and rising light
Judgment cross: a towering vertical beam and a sweeping horizontal beam form a giant cross of light over the target, cross glyph, sun seal, radiant shock and sparks
Grand cross: a giant cross of light burns into the ground under the group, two crossing light walls rise, a holy sword falls in the centre, radiant burst, feathers and sparks
Holy arrow hit: golden streak, small light pillar, cross glint, star burst and feathers
Basic light shot hit: small golden pop, star glint, short shock ring and sparkles
Basic arcane shot hit: violet pop, small vortex, star glint and motes
Void lance hit: the spear tears a black rift in the target - rift and glowing seam, imploding ring, hit spark, shadow burst and violet embers
Spirit fire hit: ghostly blue-violet flames flare up, wailing skull wisps scatter, soft smoke

Abyss gate: a colossal dark portal ring stands open over the group, the void rift tears through it, shadow tendrils and skulls lash out, everything is dragged in, then the gate implodes in a violet flash
Abyss wave: a black-violet ring of shadow ripples outward through the group, dark smoke and spirits ride the wave, violet embers
Soul reap: giant violet scythe arcs sweep the group, souls are torn out and float upward into the dark, shadow smoke
Shadow stitch: shadow needles rain down and pin the target to its own shadow - dark floor pool, needle spikes, violet sparks and binding ring
Triple shot hit: three light-arrow streaks fan into the target, hit spark, tight shock, sparks
Weak-point snipe: lock-on reticle snaps shut, a long piercing light streak, critical burst and shock ring
Deadeye: a giant lock-on reticle and rings close on the target, time stops, then a single lance of light pierces it - focus lines, white flash, double shock, star spray
Arrow rain: a seal opens in the sky and a dense rain of arrows falls over the whole group, ground glints, dust kicks, wide ring
Piercing gale: a drilling spiral of wind and arrows tears straight through the group - wind funnel on its side, long streaks, focus lines, leaves and sparks
Crow swarm: a murder of crows circles the group in a dark whirl, diving and pecking, black feathers rain, dark smoke
Gale dance: green wind seal, gusting wind arcs whirl around the target from all sides, leaf storm, sparks
Phantom raid: shadow clones vanish in violet smoke and strike from every side - criss-crossing blade arcs, X-slash, sparks and drifting phantom smoke
Poison hit: a toxic splash - green droplets and bubbles burst out, sickly smoke puff, falling specks
Acid spit: corrosive yellow-green glob splatters, sizzling droplets, hissing smoke and armour-melting fizz
Venom downpour: a sickly seal in the sky rains green arrows and toxic drops, the floor boils with miasma and bubbles
Poison spores: puffballs burst across the group in clouds of green spores, drifting motes and bubbles
Sleep: soft pastel puff, drowsy Zzz drifting up, circling little stars, bubbles
Strong blow: big hit spark, heavy crescent, shock ring, floor ring, dust and spark spray
Stunning slam: crushing blow - hit spark, shock rings, dust, then dizzy stars circle the head
Twin slash: two crossing crescents in quick succession, double hit spark, steel sparks
Cleave: one huge horizontal crescent sweeps across the whole row, trailing echo, spark spray, floor ring
Harvest scythe: a giant reaping scythe arc swings low across the group, cut leaves and chaff fly, dark green slash echo
Bleeding edge: a red-edged crescent cut, blood spray and drops, crimson hit spark
Power break: crushing downward cut, the foe's strength shatters - hit spark, falling chevrons, red shards and a weakening shock
Armor break: hit spark, the guard shell shatters into flying plates, anger mark, shock and falling chevrons
Whirlwind frenzy: spinning blade rings whirl around the group like a cyclone, wind funnel, gusting crescents, leaves and sparks
Crimson frenzy hit: blood-red crescent, claw rake, crimson hit spark and blood spray
Cataclysm: the earth splits open - giant crack seal and shockwaves, a pillar of rock and dust explodes upward, boulders fly, crimson-orange flash, rolling dust
Twin bite: two fang-marks snap shut on the target, blood spray, impact spark
Tentacle crush: dark tentacles burst up and slam down - thorny tendrils, heavy hit spark, ink splash, shock ring and dust
Root bind: thorned roots erupt from the ground and coil around the target, leaves, a binding ring tightens
Vine lash: whipping green vine crescents lash the target, thorny snap, leaves and sap droplets
Sandstorm: a tan dust funnel swirls over the group, driving sand and grit, blinding dust clouds
Protect: a blue shield crest flashes up, a hex dome closes over the ally, ring pulse and light chips
Blessing: golden light pours down from above onto the ally, rising chevrons, halo and glint
Haste: wind ring spins up at the feet, speed lines rush past, fast-orbiting feathers and chevrons, wing flash
Regen: a spiral of leaves and green crosses winds up around the ally, soft glow, sparkles
Barrier: rune seal, a large hexagonal dome assembles around the ally, ring pulse, chips of light
Cleanse: purifying droplets and bubbles wash upward, white ring pulse, sparkle and soft glow
Heal: leaf seal blooms under the ally, green petals and crosses rise, soft pillar, sparkles
Greater heal: wide blessing seal, tall heaven pillar, a bloom of petals and leaves spirals up, small wings of light and a radiant glow
Rebirth flame: golden phoenix flames rise around the group and heal - warm fire seal, gentle flame tongues, phoenix wings, feathers and crosses
Purifying light: white seal over the party, soft pillars of light, rising bubbles and droplets, ring pulses and sparkles
Sanctuary: a holy sanctuary seal on the floor and a great halo above the party, light pillars around it, soft floor glow, green motes and crosses drift up
Hymn of swiftness: musical notes and hymn glyphs whirl around the party on a gust of wind, speed lines, feathers and a wind ring
Protect all: a wide blue seal, shield crests circle the party and lock into a great hex dome, glint
Iron wall: heavy steel plates slam down around the party, a grey hex wall, crests and a dust ring
Battle cry: radial focus lines, three roaring sound waves, anger marks over the party, rising red aura flames and embers
Blood rage: crimson aura flames erupt around the warrior, blood droplets spin up, anger mark, red shock and focus lines
Provoking roar: sonic roar rings blast out, a huge anger mark, red focus lines and shock
Harden: stone plates gather and lock onto the body, grey hex shell, dust puff
Abyss wall: a dark violet hex shell rises, void swirl at its heart, shadow smoke at the feet
Photosynthesis: sunbeams shine down, leaves unfurl and spin up, green crosses, warm glow
Sun aegis: a blazing sun halo opens behind the caster, golden seal, warm sphere of light, rising embers
Hawk eye: a glowing eye opens above, a reticle spins down, feathers swirl, focus lines
Mana focus: arcane motes stream in from all around, a seal spins up, inner glow swells, star glint
Hunter's mark: a red lock-on reticle spins down onto the target and stamps, weak-point glint, falling chevrons
Dread stare: a giant evil eye opens over the target, dark rays, a skull wisp rises and the target is chilled with fear
Cursed screech: violet sound waves blast the target, silence glyph, skulls and shadow smoke
Ultrasonic screech: rapid pale sound rings ripple out, blind glyph, dizzy sparkles
Ink cloud: a black ink burst splatters the target, inky droplets, dark cloud and a blind glyph
Lullaby light: a soft pastel seal, music notes float in a lazy circle, Zzz drifts up, dreamy motes
Silent riddle: an upright rune circle spins before the target, glyph sigils orbit, a silence mark seals the mouth
Silence: a silence glyph stamps over the target, muffled ring and drifting violet motes
Silence field: a muting seal under the group, silence glyphs circle above, muffled shock ring, drifting grey-violet mist

Akashic nova: four stacked arcane seals (floor, air, sky), motes of every colour stream into the centre, then a prismatic star goes nova - blinding flash, giant star burst, double shockwave, star spray and rising light
Prism ray: a crystal prism hangs over the group and splits light into a fan of rainbow beams that rake the field, white flash, coloured star bursts
Prism hit: white pop with red, green and blue sparkles and a thin shock ring
Arrow projectile: light-arrow streak turned along its flight, thin white trail
Ice bolt projectile: faceted shard pointing along its flight, cold glow, frost trail
Holy bolt projectile: falling-light bead along its flight, golden glow, star glint, bright trail
Dark bolt projectile: spinning void swirl, violet core, needle streak along its flight, smoky trail
Fire orb projectile: white-hot meteor head with a streaming flame tail along its flight, hot trail
Sustained guard: faint hex shell, slow floor ring and rising chips of light
Sustained BREAK: dizzy stars circling the head, cracked orange floor ring, falling shell chips
